import_dir.ask: Folder where plate setup files and run requests are dropped (on the Design & Analysis PC, or a share)
import_dir.help: The package writes mhp_<job>_plate_setup.txt and mhp_<job>.json here. The person at the software imports the plate setup into the named template (More Options > Import Plate Setup), sends the plate to the instrument and starts the run.

results_dir.ask: Folder where the software's results exports land
results_dir.help: Actions > Export, CSV or TXT, with the Results table included; name the export after the request token (mhp_<job>).

software.ask: Design & Analysis version on the PC (for the record)

reporter.ask: Reporter dye written into the plate setup file

quencher.ask: Quencher written into the plate setup file (NFQ-MGB for TaqMan, None for SYBR)

allowed_templates.ask: Template file names an agent may queue (JSON list; empty allows any)

result_wait_s.ask: Seconds to wait for the results export before the job fails

poll_s.ask: Seconds between looks at the results folder
